Facts established before asking

Geo lives on connections only location is a field on StoredConnection (store/connections-store.ts:72). ConversationRecord — the contact record — has no location field at all.
Nothing queries the connections store There is no contacts command. search matches conversations by name; grep scans message bodies. The connections store has no read surface.
The structure is already on the wire The core profiles response carries geoLocation["*geo"] → urn:li:fsd_geo:90000064 and location.countryCode "US" (tests/unit/profile-detail.test.ts:57). We fetch it and throw it away.
Granularity is metro, not city LinkedIn returns "Austin, Texas Metropolitan Area". There is no city field to extract — the issue's "city / region / country" asks for precision the source never gave.

Enrich dataflow today — and what it drops

Four requests per profile in --deep, two in core. Everything funnels through one included[] graph parse, and resolveLocation() (profile-detail.ts:259) collapses a structured Geo reference into a single display string. The red path is the data we already paid for and discard.
